items.title: Connecting Python to a Database (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Connecting Python to a Database (PDF 58, printed 54), paragraph for paragraph with the English; Code Explanation boxes and runnable examples added 2026-10-29.

blocks.text: Python ko database se jorne se program mehfooz (stored) data ke saath kaam kar sakta hai. Data ka koi bhi kaam karne se pehle database connection zaroori hai. Python aisi libraries deta hai jo yeh connection aasani se banati hain. Jurne ke baad data dala, nikala ya badla ja sakta hai. Connection ko theek tarah sambhalne se Python aur database ke darmiyan baat cheet aasani se chalti hai.

items: Data ka koi bhi kaam karne se pehle connection zaroori hai.
